text: Ko haɗnoo wona e gire leptanooɓe adiiɓe on ɓen, immorde e joomiraaɓe ɓural e moƴƴere, ɓe no haɗa ɗen gire e keeferaaku e bonnirgol geddi ka leydi! Heɓanooki e ɓen heddinooɓe, si wanaa seeɗaaɓe e ɓen e maɓɓe ɓe no haɗa e bonnugol. Men daɗndiɓe tuma Men halkunoo yimɓe maɓɓe tooñuɓe ɓen. Yimɓe maɓɓe tooñuɓe ɓen jokki e ko ɓe neeminaa kon e mun, ɓe laatii tooñirɓe jokkugol ɗum.
